hints.text: You are told what number $x$ is. Use that number in place of the letter.
Swap $x$ for $6$, which turns $x + 4$ into the plain sum $6 + 4$.
Six plus four makes ten, so $x + 4$ equals $10$.

explanation: The letter $x$ stands for $6$ in this problem, so write $6$ where $x$ is.
The expression $x + 4$ becomes the plain sum $6 + 4$.
Adding gives $10$, so the value of $x + 4$ is $10$.
